name: Alan Turing
role: The father of theoretical computer science
bio: Mathematician. Codebreaker. A mind that helped define what a machine could think. His work laid the foundations of modern computing.

name: Margaret Hamilton
bio: Led the team that developed the onboard flight software for NASA’s Apollo missions. Her approach to reliability helped make the Moon landing possible.

name: John Carmack
bio: A pioneering engineer behind Doom and Quake, whose work in real-time 3D graphics changed how we build and experience virtual worlds.

name: Grace Hopper
bio: A pioneer of compiler technology who helped shape COBOL and made programming more accessible through human-readable languages.

name: Linus Torvalds
bio: Created the Linux kernel and Git, two essential foundations of open source collaboration and modern software development.

name: Ada Lovelace
bio: Her notes on the Analytical Engine included an algorithm intended for a machine and a remarkable vision for computing beyond arithmetic.

name: Leonardo dos Santos Sousa
bio: Brazilian full stack software developer focused on web applications, APIs, and software architecture. Creator of HowManyTime.
